_metadata.title: ISRIC SoilGrids 250m & Geotechnical Foundation Benchmarks
_metadata.disclaimer: Regional estimates based on ISRIC 250m depth profiles. Mandatory site borehole SPT cores required per BIS IS 1892 & 1904.

noida.foundation_recommendation: Raft foundation with perimeter retaining piling for towers >15 floors; deep borehole SPT cores required to detect liquefaction potential in fine sand lenses.

delhi.foundation_recommendation: Isolated/combined footings or raft foundation on dense strata; pile foundation where near Yamuna floodplains.
delhi.liquefaction_susceptibility: Moderate to High near Yamuna banks

bengaluru.soil_taxonomy: Red Gravelly Sandy Loam over Charnockite / Peninsular Gneiss
bengaluru.foundation_recommendation: Isolated or mat footings directly bearing on weathered granite/gneiss; low foundation cost relative to alluvial soils.

mumbai.soil_taxonomy: Coastal Alluvium over Deccan Trap Basalt
mumbai.foundation_recommendation: End-bearing driven/bored piles terminating in basaltic bedrock; basement dewatering and waterproof diaphragm walls mandatory.

hyderabad.soil_taxonomy: Red Gravelly Sandy Clay over Granitic plutons
hyderabad.foundation_recommendation: Pad footings or shallow raft directly on firm weathered granite.
